caption: "primetime" — 500,000+ searches this week. Plus 100,000+ for "chris hansen".

Why: A24's Primetime opened in US theaters on September 25, with Robert Pattinson as Chris Hansen, the host of Dateline's To Catch a Predator. Hansen has seen it. He called it "so detached from reality" and gave Pattinson's performance a D.

What most people don't know: the young decoy Phoebe Bridgers plays is a real person. Del Harvey posed as a minor for the show's volunteer group, Perverted-Justice, then joined Twitter in 2008 and became its vice president of trust and safety.
Very simply put: she went from baiting predators for TV to fighting abuse at Twitter.

slides.headline: To Catch a Predator ran on Dateline NBC from *2004 to 2007*.
slides.sub: 20 episodes. One sting in Mira Loma, California, caught 51 men.
